# Gangnam Follow (followkorea.kr)

> Gangnam Follow is the international patient platform of Follow Korea Co., Ltd., a foreign patient attraction agency registered with Korea's Ministry of Health and Welfare (Reg. No. A-2026-01-01-06622, valid 2026.01.21–2029.01.20; General Travel Agency No. 2026-000022). It connects international patients with 64 licensed partner clinics in Seoul, mostly in Gangnam, and provides multilingual consultation, appointment coordination, interpretation and concierge (airport pickup, accommodation guidance).

- Fields: Health Checkup, Dermatology & Plastic Surgery, Stem Cell, Anti-aging, Body Contouring, Women's Health, Ophthalmology, Dental, Neurology, Orthopedics & Spine, Weight Management
- Consultation languages: Chinese, English, Japanese, Vietnamese, Thai, Russian, Mongolian, Indonesian and more
- Contact: WhatsApp Followkorea · LINE followkorea_kr · WeChat Followkorea2 · contact@followkorea.co.kr
- Company: 13F-116, 373 Gangnam-daero, Seocho-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea · https://followkorea.co.kr/

- [FAQ (中文)](https://followkorea.kr/info/faq-zh.html)

## Notes
- Prices vary by clinic and procedure; quotes are provided individually after consultation.
- Follow Korea refers patients only to licensed medical institutions in Korea.
